label: Lemlist

operations.name: create_lead_in_campaign
operations.description: Creates a new lead and adds it to a specific campaign. Never updates an existing lead. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/).

operations.name: enrich_data
operations.description: Enriches data by finding emails, phone numbers, or LinkedIn information from various inputs. (POST /enrich).

operations.name: search_people_database
operations.description: Searches the people database using filters, keywords, and pagination. (POST /database/people).

operations.name: add_webhook
operations.description: Creates a webhook that receives real-time POST callbacks for selected events. (POST /hooks).

operations.name: get_lead_by_email
operations.description: Retrieves a specific lead by their email address. (GET /leads/{email}).

operations.name: get_team
operations.description: Retrieves information about your team. (GET /team).

operations.name: get_team_senders
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all team members and their associated campaigns. (GET /team/senders).

operations.name: get_team_credits
operations.description: Retrieves the remaining credits balance for your team's account. (GET /team/credits).

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Retrieves all information for a specific user by their ID. (GET /users/{userId}).

operations.name: get_user_channels
operations.description: Retrieves the connected channels (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) and their availability for the authenticated user. (GET /user/channels).

operations.name: connect_email_account
operations.description: Connects a new SMTP/IMAP email account to your team. (POST /user/email-accounts).

operations.name: disconnect_email_account
operations.description: Disconnects an email account from your team. (DELETE /user/email-accounts/{emailAccountId}).

operations.name: test_email_account
operations.description: Tests the SMTP and IMAP connection of an email account. (POST /user/email-accounts/{emailAccountId}/test).

operations.name: create_campaign
operations.description: Creates a new campaign with auto-generated sequence and schedule. (POST /campaigns).

operations.name: get_campaign
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific campaign by ID. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}).

operations.name: get_many_campaigns
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all campaigns in your team. (GET /campaigns).

operations.name: update_campaign
operations.description: Updates the settings and configuration of an existing campaign. (PATCH /campaigns/{campaignId}).

operations.name: get_campaign_statutes
operations.description: Retrieves validation statutes for a campaign, including errors that block launching and warnings about daily limits, DNS issues, etc. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/statutes).

operations.name: start_campaign
operations.description: Starts or resumes a paused campaign. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/start).

operations.name: pause_campaign
operations.description: Pauses a running campaign without affecting scheduled leads. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/pause).

operations.name: skip_step_for_everyone
operations.description: Skips one step of a running campaign for every lead. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/steps/{stepId}/skip).

operations.name: duplicate_campaign
operations.description: Duplicates an existing campaign with all its sequences, schedules, and templates. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/duplicate).

operations.name: get_campaign_stats
operations.description: Retrieves performance statistics for a specific campaign. (GET /v2/campaigns/{campaignId}/stats).

operations.name: get_batch_campaign_stats
operations.description: Retrieves performance statistics for multiple campaigns in a single request. (POST /v2/campaigns/stats/batch).

operations.name: start_campaign_stats_export
operations.description: Initiates an asynchronous export of campaign statistics to a CSV file. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/export/start).

operations.name: get_campaign_export_status
operations.description: Checks the status of an asynchronous campaign export. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/export/{exportId}/status).

operations.name: set_email_for_campaign_export_notification
operations.display_name: Set Email for Campaign Export Notification
operations.description: Configures email notification delivery when a campaign export completes. (PUT /campaigns/{campaignId}/export/{exportId}/email/{email}).

operations.name: export_campaign_leads
operations.description: Exports leads from a campaign with flexible filtering and format options. (GET /v2/campaigns/{campaignId}/export/leads).

operations.name: export_campaign_leads_legacy
operations.description: Exports leads from a campaign with flexible filtering and format options. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/export/leads).

operations.name: get_campaign_reports
operations.description: Retrieves aggregated reports and statistics for one or multiple campaigns. (GET /campaigns/reports).

operations.name: get_campaign_sequences
operations.description: Retrieves all sequences and their steps for a specific campaign. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/sequences).

operations.name: add_step_to_sequence
operations.description: Creates a step or condition within a campaign sequence. (POST /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps).

operations.name: update_sequence_step
operations.description: Updates an existing step within a sequence. (PATCH /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}).

operations.name: delete_sequence_step
operations.description: Deletes a specific step from a sequence. (DELETE /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}).

operations.name: list_condition_branches
operations.description: Lists the branches of a condition step, in execution order. (GET /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/branches).

operations.name: add_condition_branch
operations.description: Adds a branch to a condition step and returns it. (POST /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/branches).

operations.name: reorder_condition_branches
operations.description: Rewrites the execution priority of a condition step's branches. (PATCH /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/branches).

operations.name: update_condition_branch
operations.description: Renames a branch and/or changes what it tests. (PATCH /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/branches/{branchSequenceId}).

operations.name: delete_condition_branch
operations.description: Removes a branch and the sub-tree behind it. (DELETE /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/branches/{branchSequenceId}).

operations.name: create_a_b_test_variant
operations.description: Creates variant B of an A/B test on a step, prefilled from variant A. (POST /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/ab-test).

operations.name: get_a_b_test_variant
operations.description: Returns variant B (subject, content, config) of the A/B test on a step. (GET /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/ab-test).

operations.name: update_a_b_test_variant
operations.description: Edits variant B content and config of the A/B test on a step. (PATCH /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/ab-test).

operations.name: delete_a_b_test_variant
operations.description: Deletes a variant of the A/B test and ends the test. (DELETE /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/ab-test).

operations.name: select_a_b_test_winner
operations.description: Selects the winning A/B test variant, applied to all remaining leads. (POST /sequences/{sequenceId}/steps/{stepId}/ab-test/winner).

operations.name: list_message_templates
operations.description: Lists the team's library message templates, newest first. (GET /message-templates).

operations.name: list_message_template_tags
operations.description: Lists the distinct tags of the team's library message templates, alphabetically. (GET /message-templates/tags).

operations.name: get_message_template
operations.description: Returns one library message template with its body. (GET /message-templates/{templateId}).

operations.name: list_snippets
operations.description: Lists the team's snippets by name. (GET /snippets).

operations.name: get_snippet
operations.description: Returns one snippet with its content. (GET /snippets/{snippetId}).

operations.name: create_schedule
operations.description: Creates a new schedule with customizable timing and timezone settings. (POST /schedules).

operations.name: get_schedule
operations.description: Retrieves details of a specific schedule. (GET /schedules/{scheduleId}).

operations.name: get_many_schedules
operations.description: Retrieves all schedules for your team. (GET /schedules).

operations.name: update_schedule
operations.description: Updates an existing schedule's parameters. (PATCH /schedules/{scheduleId}).

operations.name: delete_schedule
operations.description: Deletes a specific schedule. (DELETE /schedules/{scheduleId}).

operations.name: get_campaign_schedules
operations.description: Retrieves all schedules associated with a specific campaign. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/schedules/).

operations.name: associate_schedule_with_campaign
operations.description: Associates a schedule with a campaign. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/schedules/{scheduleId}).

operations.name: get_campaign_leads
operations.description: Retrieves leads from a specific campaign, optionally filtered by state. (GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/).

operations.name: get_lead_by_email_or_id
operations.display_name: Get Lead by Email or ID
operations.description: Retrieves a lead using their email address or lead ID. (GET /leads).

operations.name: update_lead_in_a_campaign
operations.description: Updates an existing lead's information in a specific campaign. (PATCH /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadId}).

operations.name: delete_or_unsubscribe_lead
operations.description: Removes a lead from a campaign or unsubscribes it permanently. (DELETE /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadId}).

operations.name: add_custom_variables_on_leads
operations.description: Adds new custom variables to a lead. (POST /leads/{leadId}/variables).

operations.name: update_values_of_custom_variables_of_a_lead
operations.display_name: Update Values of Custom Variables of a Lead
operations.description: Updates the values of custom variables on a lead. (PATCH /leads/{leadId}/variables).

operations.name: erase_values_of_custom_variables_on_a_lead
operations.display_name: Erase Values of Custom Variables on a Lead
operations.description: Erases the values of custom variables on a lead. (DELETE /leads/{leadId}/variables).

operations.name: unsubscribe_lead_from_campaign
operations.description: Unsubscribes a lead from a lemlist campaign. (DELETE /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{email}).

operations.name: pause_lead
operations.description: Pauses a lead's activity in all campaigns or a specific campaign. (POST /leads/pause/{leadId}).

operations.name: resume_paused_lead
operations.description: Resumes a paused lead in all campaigns or a specific campaign. (POST /leads/start/{leadId}).

operations.name: launch_lead
operations.description: Manually launches (reviews) a single lead in its campaign. (POST /leads/review/{leadId}).

operations.name: mark_lead_as_interested
operations.description: Marks a lead as interested across all campaigns. (POST /leads/interested/{leadIdOrEmail}).

operations.name: mark_lead_as_not_interested
operations.description: Marks a lead as not interested across all campaigns. (POST /leads/notinterested/{leadIdOrEmail}).

operations.name: mark_lead_as_interested_in_campaign
operations.display_name: Mark Lead as Interested in Campaign
operations.description: Marks a lead as interested in a specific campaign. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadIdOrEmail}/interested).

operations.name: mark_lead_as_not_interested_in_campaign
operations.display_name: Mark Lead as Not Interested in Campaign
operations.description: Marks a lead as not interested in a specific campaign. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadIdOrEmail}/notinterested).

operations.name: skip_step_for_lead
operations.description: Skips one step of a running campaign for a single lead. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadIdOrEmail}/steps/{stepId}/skip).

operations.name: personalize_step_for_lead
operations.description: Personalizes the message of one campaign step for a single lead. (PUT /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadIdOrEmail}/steps/{stepId}/personalization).

operations.name: reset_step_personalization_for_lead
operations.description: Removes a lead's personalization of one campaign step. (DELETE /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/{leadIdOrEmail}/steps/{stepId}/personalization).

operations.name: import_leads_from_crm
operations.description: Links a campaign to a filter of your connected CRM and imports its records as leads, now and as the filter picks up new ones. (POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/leads/import).

operations.name: upload_audio_for_voice_message_step
operations.display_name: Upload Audio for Voice Message Step
operations.description: Uploads an audio file for voice message steps in campaign sequences. (POST /leads/audio).

operations.name: add_and_update_company
operations.description: Creates a new company or updates an existing one based on domain or LinkedIn URL. (POST /companies).

operations.name: get_many_companies
operations.description: Retrieves companies from your CRM. Use `idsOrDomains` to fetch specific companies by ID or domain in a single request (max 100), or omit it to get a paginated list of all companies. (GET /companies).

operations.name: delete_company
operations.description: Deletes a lemlist company. Use `force=true` to detach attached contacts before deletion. (DELETE /companies/{companyId}).

operations.name: merge_companies
operations.description: Merges up to 10 lemlist companies into one survivor, moving everything attached to the deleted companies onto it. (POST /companies/merge).

operations.name: get_company_lists
operations.description: Retrieves all company lists for the team, with optional name filtering. (GET /companies/lists).

operations.name: create_company_list
operations.description: Creates a new static company list. (POST /companies/lists).

operations.name: add_or_remove_companies_in_a_list
operations.display_name: Add or Remove Companies in a List
operations.description: Add companies to a static company list, or remove them with ?action=remove. (POST /companies/lists/{listId}/entities).

operations.name: create_company_note
operations.description: Creates a new note attached to a specific company. (POST /companies/{companyId}/notes).

operations.name: get_company_notes
operations.description: Retrieves all notes associated with a specific company. (GET /companies/{companyId}/notes).

operations.name: add_and_update_contact
operations.description: Creates a new contact or updates an existing one based on email or LinkedIn URL. (POST /contacts).

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Retrieves a specific contact by their ID or email address. (GET /contacts/{idOrEmail}).

operations.name: get_many_contacts
operations.description: Retrieves contacts from your CRM. Use `idsOrEmails` to fetch specific contacts by ID or email in a single request (max 100), or omit it to search/list contacts by name, email, contact list, or campaign membership. (GET /contacts).

operations.name: delete_contact
operations.description: Deletes a lemlist contact by id or email. Cascades to leads, opportunities, lists, inbox and activities. (DELETE /contacts/{idOrEmail}).

operations.name: merge_contacts
operations.description: Merges up to 10 lemlist contacts into one survivor, moving everything attached to the deleted contacts onto it. (POST /contacts/merge).

operations.name: get_contact_lists
operations.description: Retrieves all contact lists for the team, with optional name filtering. (GET /contacts/lists).

operations.name: create_contact_list
operations.description: Creates a new static contact list. (POST /contacts/lists).

operations.name: add_or_remove_contacts_in_a_list
operations.display_name: Add or Remove Contacts in a List
operations.description: Add contacts to a static contact list, or remove them with ?action=remove. (POST /contacts/lists/{listId}/entities).

operations.name: export_contact_list
operations.description: Exports contacts or companies from a CRM list as a CSV file. (GET /contacts/export).

operations.name: get_many_inboxes
operations.description: Retrieves all inbox conversations for your team. (GET /inbox).

operations.name: get_contact_messages
operations.description: Retrieves all messages exchanged with a specific contact. (GET /inbox/{contactId}).

operations.name: send_email
operations.description: Sends an email to a contact through the lemlist inbox. Set replyToActivityId to reply within an existing thread (reuses the thread's subject and CC). (POST /inbox/email).

operations.name: send_linkedin_message
operations.description: Sends a LinkedIn message to a contact through the lemlist inbox. (POST /inbox/linkedin).

operations.name: send_whatsapp_message
operations.description: Sends a WhatsApp message to a contact through the lemlist inbox. (POST /inbox/whatsapp).

operations.name: send_sms_message
operations.description: Sends an SMS message to a contact through the lemlist inbox. (POST /inbox/sms).

operations.name: get_many_labels
operations.description: List all labels available to your team. (GET /inbox/labels).

operations.name: get_label
operations.description: Get info of a specific label. (GET /inbox/labels/{labelId}).

operations.name: create_label
operations.description: Creates a new label available to the team. (POST /inbox/labels).

operations.name: attach_labels_to_conversations
operations.description: Attaches one or more labels to one or more conversations. (POST /inbox/conversations/labels/{contactId}).

operations.name: remove_labels_from_conversation
operations.description: Removes one or more labels from one conversation. (DELETE /inbox/conversations/labels/{contactId}).

operations.name: list_drafts
operations.description: Lists all non-deleted drafts for a specific contact. (GET /inbox/{contactId}/drafts).

operations.name: get_draft
operations.description: Retrieves a single draft with its full content, including attachments. (GET /inbox/{contactId}/drafts/{draftId}).

operations.name: create_draft
operations.description: Creates a new draft for a specific contact. The source is automatically set to "api". (POST /inbox/{contactId}/drafts).

operations.name: update_draft
operations.description: Partially updates an existing draft. Only the provided fields will be updated. (PATCH /inbox/{contactId}/drafts/{draftId}).

operations.name: delete_draft
operations.description: Soft-deletes a draft by setting its deletedAt timestamp. (DELETE /inbox/{contactId}/drafts/{draftId}).

operations.name: create_task
operations.description: Create a manual task (opportunity) associated with a contact/company or lead. (POST /tasks).

operations.name: search_tasks
operations.description: Searches your team's tasks with the filters of the Tasks page, and returns every status. (GET /v2/tasks).

operations.name: list_task_filters
operations.description: Lists every field you can use in the advancedFilters tree of Search Tasks. (GET /v2/tasks/filters).

operations.name: get_many_tasks
operations.description: Retrieves all pending tasks assigned to your team members. (GET /tasks).

operations.name: update_task
operations.description: Modifies aspects of an existing task including assignment, scheduling, and status. (PATCH /tasks).

operations.name: ignore_tasks
operations.description: Marks one or more tasks as ignored. (POST /tasks/ignore).

operations.name: get_many_activities
operations.description: Retrieves the history of all campaign activities and steps performed (optionally filtered by activity type and campaign). (GET /activities).

operations.name: delete_activity_recording_transcript
operations.description: Deletes the call recording and transcript associated with an activity. (DELETE /activities/{activityId}/recording-transcript).

operations.name: get_team_crm_users
operations.description: Retrieves the team members whose CRM account is connected to lemlist. (GET /team/crmUsers).

operations.name: get_crm_filters
operations.description: Retrieves the filters of your team's connected CRM that leads can be imported from. (GET /crm/filters).

operations.name: list_unsubscribed_variables
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all unsubscribed variables (emails, domains, LinkedIn URLs, phone numbers). (GET /v2/unsubscribes/variables).

operations.name: get_unsubscribed_variable
operations.description: Retrieves a specific unsubscribed variable by its value. (GET /v2/unsubscribes/variables/{value}).

operations.name: unsubscribe_variable
operations.description: Unsubscribes a single variable. Idempotent — returns the existing record if already unsubscribed. (POST /v2/unsubscribes/variables/{value}).

operations.name: bulk_unsubscribe_variables
operations.description: Unsubscribes up to 10,000 variables in a single request. (POST /v2/unsubscribes/variables).

operations.name: re_subscribe_variable
operations.description: Re-subscribes a variable, removing it from the unsubscribe list. (DELETE /v2/unsubscribes/variables/{value}).

operations.name: export_unsubscribed_variables
operations.description: Exports all unsubscribed variables as CSV (default) or JSON. (GET /v2/unsubscribes/exports/variables).

operations.name: get_contact_subscription_status
operations.description: Checks whether a contact is unsubscribed (do-not-contact). (GET /v2/unsubscribes/contacts/{contactId}).

operations.name: unsubscribe_contact
operations.description: Marks a contact as unsubscribed (do-not-contact). (POST /v2/unsubscribes/contacts/{contactId}).

operations.name: re_subscribe_contact
operations.description: Re-subscribes a contact, removing the do-not-contact flag. (DELETE /v2/unsubscribes/contacts/{contactId}).

operations.name: export_unsubscribed_contacts
operations.description: Exports all contacts with their subscription status as CSV (default) or JSON. (GET /v2/unsubscribes/exports/contacts).

operations.name: add_unsubscribe_email_or_domain
operations.description: Adds an email address or domain to your unsubscribe list. (POST /unsubscribes/{email}).

operations.name: get_unsubscribe_by_email
operations.description: Retrieves unsubscribe information for a specific email address. (GET /unsubscribes/{email}).

operations.name: get_many_unsubscribes
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all unsubscribed emails and domains. (GET /unsubscribes).

operations.name: delete_unsubscribe_email
operations.description: Removes an email address from your unsubscribe list. (DELETE /unsubscribes/{email}).

operations.name: export_unsubscribes
operations.description: Exports all unsubscribed emails and domains to a CSV file. (GET /unsubs/export).

operations.name: delete_webhook
operations.description: Deletes a specific webhook. (DELETE /hooks/{hookId}).

operations.name: get_many_webhooks
operations.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for your team. (GET /hooks).

operations.name: search_companies_database
operations.description: Searches the companies database using filters, keywords, and pagination. (POST /database/companies).

operations.name: get_database_filters
operations.description: Retrieves available filters for searching the people and companies database. (GET /database/filters).

operations.name: list_personas
operations.description: Retrieves the People Database personas saved by your team. (GET /database/personas).

operations.name: create_persona
operations.description: Creates a People Database persona for your team. (POST /database/personas).

operations.name: delete_persona
operations.description: Deletes a People Database persona. (DELETE /database/personas/{personaId}).

operations.name: run_contact_sourcing
operations.description: Starts an AI contact-sourcing run for one or more accounts. (POST /contact-sourcing).

operations.name: get_contact_sourcing_run
operations.description: Reads a contact-sourcing run by ID, or the latest run of an account. (GET /contact-sourcing).

operations.name: add_a_sourced_contact
operations.description: Turns one contact-sourcing recommendation into a lemlist contact. (POST /contact-sourcing/contacts).

operations.name: bulk_enrich_data
operations.description: Performs batch enrichment for up to 500 entities to find emails, phone numbers, or LinkedIn data. (POST /v2/enrichments/bulk).

operations.name: enrich_lead
operations.description: Enriches an existing lead in lemlist with additional data. (POST /leads/{leadId}/enrich).

operations.name: get_enrichment_result
operations.description: Retrieves the results of a completed enrichment request. (GET /enrich/{enrichId}).

operations.name: list_enrichment_providers
operations.description: Lists the enrichment providers your team can place in a waterfall, for one enrichment type. (GET /v2/enrichments/providers).

operations.name: connect_provider
operations.description: Saves your own API key for an external enrichment provider, connecting it for your waterfalls. (PUT /v2/enrichments/providers/{providerId}/connection).

operations.name: disconnect_provider
operations.description: Removes the API key of an external enrichment provider; lemlist stops calling it on your account. (DELETE /v2/enrichments/providers/{providerId}/connection).

operations.name: list_enrichment_waterfalls
operations.description: Lists your team's enrichment waterfalls — the default waterfall of each type, plus every custom waterfall. (GET /v2/enrichments/waterfalls).

operations.name: get_enrichment_waterfall
operations.description: Returns one enrichment waterfall of your team, default or custom. (GET /v2/enrichments/waterfalls/{waterfallId}).

operations.name: update_enrichment_waterfall
operations.description: Updates the name or provider order of an enrichment waterfall. (PATCH /v2/enrichments/waterfalls/{waterfallId}).

operations.name: reset_enrichment_waterfall
operations.description: Hands a default enrichment waterfall back to lemlist, restoring its random provider order. (PUT /v2/enrichments/waterfalls/{waterfallId}/reset).

operations.name: start_lemwarm
operations.description: Starts lemwarm email deliverability improvement for a specific user mailbox. (POST /lemwarm/{userMailboxId}/start).

operations.name: pause_lemwarm
operations.description: Pauses lemwarm email deliverability improvement for a specific user mailbox. (POST /lemwarm/{userMailboxId}/pause).

operations.name: get_lemwarm_settings
operations.description: Retrieves lemwarm email deliverability settings for a specific user mailbox. (GET /lemwarm/{userMailboxId}/settings).

operations.name: update_lemwarm_settings
operations.description: Updates lemwarm email deliverability settings for a specific user mailbox. (PATCH /lemwarm/{userMailboxId}/settings).

operations.name: list_signal_agents
operations.description: Retrieves your Signal Agents (watch lists) with pagination and optional filtering by signal type and status. (GET /watchlist).

operations.name: create_signal_agent
operations.description: Creates a new Signal Agent (watch list). (POST /watchlist).

operations.name: update_signal_agent
operations.description: Updates an existing Signal Agent (watch list). (PATCH /watchlist).

operations.name: delete_signal_agent
operations.description: Deletes a Signal Agent (watch list). (DELETE /watchlist).

operations.name: get_signal_agent_configuration_history
operations.description: Retrieves the configuration history of a Signal Agent — each past config version with its active period and stats. (GET /watchlist/history).

operations.name: get_signal_agent_signals
operations.description: Retrieves paginated signals detected by your Signal Agents with filtering and sorting capabilities. (GET /watchlist/signals).

operations.name: mark_signals_handled_or_ignored
operations.description: Marks one or several signals as handled or ignored. (PUT /watchlist/signals).

operations.name: push_external_signals
operations.description: Pushes a contact- or company-level external signal into a Signal Agent. (POST /watchlist/{watchListId}/external-signals).

operations.name: list_available_signal_types
operations.description: Lists the signal types available to your team, each with a title and description. (GET /watchlist/library).

operations.name: list_allowed_filters_per_signal_type
operations.display_name: List allowed filters per signal type
operations.description: Lists, per signal type, the filters you can set on a Signal Agent. (GET /watchlist/filters).

operations.name: autocomplete_filter_values
operations.description: Autocompletes allowed values for a Signal Agent filter (job titles, industries, locations, company sizes, and more). (GET /watchlist/filter-values).

operations.name: list_deliverability_alerts
operations.description: Lists all deliverability alert configurations for your team. (GET /deliverability/alerts).

operations.name: create_deliverability_alert
operations.description: Creates a new deliverability alert that monitors a warm-up or outreach metric and notifies you through the configured channels when the threshold is breached. (POST /deliverability/alerts).

operations.name: get_deliverability_alert
operations.description: Retrieves a single deliverability alert configuration by its ID. (GET /deliverability/alerts/{alertId}).

operations.name: update_deliverability_alert
operations.description: Updates a deliverability alert's threshold, evaluation window, notification channels, scope filter, or enabled state. (PATCH /deliverability/alerts/{alertId}).

operations.name: delete_deliverability_alert
operations.description: Permanently deletes a deliverability alert configuration. The historical alert occurrences this configuration produced are not removed. (DELETE /deliverability/alerts/{alertId}).

operations.name: list_fields
operations.description: Lists all available fields for contacts and companies. (GET /fields).

summary: All documented Lemlist API operations using the account API key.
